root_cause.text: The `iris_vb2_stop_streaming` function incorrectly skipped the stop streaming process and buffer cleanup when the iris instance was in the `IRIS_INST_ERROR` state, preventing proper teardown and failing to return buffers to the vb2 core.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the removal of the check `if (inst->state == IRIS_INST_ERROR) goto exit;` in `iris_vb2_stop_streaming` and ensures `iris_helper_buffers_done` is called unconditionally at the exit block. This is supported by the commit message, which states that skipping `stop_streaming` when the instance was in `IRIS_INST_ERROR` prevented buffers from being returned to vb2 and blocked proper teardown.

bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces the vulnerability. It adds a check `if (inst->state == IRIS_INST_ERROR) goto exit;` and modifies the `exit` block so that `iris_helper_buffers_done` is only called `if (ret)`. When `inst->state == IRIS_INST_ERROR` is true, the code jumps to `exit` with `ret` being 0, which skips the call to `iris_helper_buffers_done(inst, q->type, VB2_BUF_STATE_ERROR)`.
